_: Generated by tools/gen_gifts.py. gifts: powers (moves + rule). marked: the young gangsters who carry them. bosses: which boss has which.

cinder.name: Cinder Gift
cinder.tip: Her fire hates water. Fight her beside the harbour, or in the rain, and every hit counts double. Dry, she barely feels it. Her dashes leave fire on the ground: cross behind her, not along the trail.
cinder.lend_desc: A ring of fire: burns everything close.

volt.name: Volt Gift
volt.tip: She blinks away from anything you swing while she is charged. Sidestep the three bolts: after the last one she is spent for two seconds. That is your whole fight.
volt.lend_desc: A bolt down the line you face.

mirror.name: Mirror Gift
mirror.tip: He splits into three. Reflections cast no shadow: hit the one standing on a shadow. The copies break in one hit but each still throws glass.
mirror.lend_desc: A flash of mirrors: everything near is dazed.

bramble.name: Bramble Gift
bramble.tip: Bark covers her front. She turns slowly: get behind her and hit her in the back. Her roots slow you, so move before the circles close.
bramble.lend_desc: Roots hold everything near in place.

gale.name: Gale Gift
gale.tip: You can't hit the wind. She has to land after every dash: that second is the only time she's really there.
gale.lend_desc: Blows everything back and puts the wind at your heels.

iron.name: Iron Gift
iron.tip: While he is iron, nothing marks him. It lasts five seconds, then he has to breathe for three. Keep your distance while he is grey; go in when the ring around him turns white.
iron.lend_desc: Iron skin: hits land much softer for a while.

shade.name: Shade Gift
shade.tip: She vanishes and comes out behind you. Keep moving when she is gone, then turn: she is solid for a breath after every strike.
shade.lend_desc: Step into shadow: nothing can touch you for three seconds.

beat.name: Tempo Gift
beat.tip: Everything he does lands on the beat. Hit him on the beat and he parries. Hit him just after it, when the ring around him flashes white.
beat.lend_desc: Two pulses, on the beat, through everything near.

fortune.name: Fortune Gift
fortune.tip: She rolls for everything, and her luck holds for exactly three rolls. On the third it runs out for four seconds. Count her rolls.
fortune.lend_desc: A roll of the dice: crystals, health, or a hard hit.

gravity.name: Gravity Gift
gravity.tip: Up close you are fighting the ground itself. Run out of the pull before the slam, or hit him from range. After every slam he is stuck for a moment.
gravity.lend_desc: Drags everything near to your feet and hits it.

b_grudge.name: The Grudge
b_grudge.tip: It drags you in to slam. Get clear of the slam, then it is winded.

b_command.name: Marching Orders
b_command.tip: The shield faces front. Step round it.

b_king.name: Heart of Stone
b_king.tip: Stone for six seconds, then it has to rest. Hit it when the ring turns white.

b_warden.name: The Long Watch
b_warden.tip: Count the beams. After the last one the Warden is blind for a moment. At half health, only one of them has a shadow.

b_witch.name: Bog Song
b_witch.tip: She sinks into the bog and comes up behind you. That is when she can be hit hard.

b_president.name: Every Gift At Once
b_president.tip: He uses the Gifts he handed out, one after another. Every time he rolls the dice the stone stutters and he is open for three seconds. Watch for the dice.

b_dark.name: The Source
b_dark.tip: Every Gift came from here, and it throws all of them. It dims every few seconds: that is the only time it can be hurt badly.

b_elder.name: Mind Fog
b_elder.tip: It goes out like a light and comes back behind you. Turn and hit it then.

b_sentinel.name: Black Glass
b_sentinel.tip: Its face is armoured. Its back is not.

b_mirror.name: Your Own Face
b_mirror.tip: Only one of them casts a shadow.

b_eater.name: The Hunger
b_eater.tip: Stay out of its reach, or hit it while it is pulling and just after it has swallowed.

lt_tide.name: Undertow
lt_tide.tip: He drags you toward the slam. Break out sideways; after each slam he stands in his own puddle, open, for two seconds.

lt_neonfire.name: Neon Burn
lt_neonfire.tip: Her spiral burns her out. Stay outside it, then close in while the neon sputters.

lt_anvil.name: Unbroken
lt_anvil.tip: Iron skin for a few seconds, then he gasps. Dodge while he is grey; punish the gasp.

lt_grid.name: Power Grid
lt_grid.tip: His shield faces you. Bait the bolts, roll past, and hit him from behind before he turns.

lt_thicket.name: Thicket
lt_thicket.tip: She vanishes into the hedges and steps out behind you. Turn the moment she reappears.

lt_gravity.name: Survey Lines
lt_gravity.tip: Up close the ground is his. Fight from range, or wait for the slam and rush in.

lt_express.name: Express
lt_express.tip: He comes through like a train, three times. Step off the line; he skids to a stop after each run.

lt_ledger.name: The Ledger
lt_ledger.tip: Her luck lasts three rolls. Count them. At low health only one of her has a shadow.

c_coral.name: Choking Reef
c_coral.tip: Its front is armoured reef. Bait the circles, step round, and hit it from behind.

c_kelp.name: Drowning Tide
c_kelp.tip: Get out of the tide's pull, wait out the spiral, then hit it while it's spent.

c_ice.name: Hollow Winter
c_ice.tip: Its reflections cast no shadow. Hit the one with a shadow.

c_ember.name: Smother
c_ember.tip: It burns too hot to touch, then has to cool. Dodge the trails; strike when the ring goes white.

kit.name: Kit Lindqvist
kit.intro: You're the one everyone's whispering about? You're slow.
kit.yield: Okay. OKAY. You caught the wind. Nobody catches the wind.
kit.origin: I got it the night a man in a grey suit gave me a little black stone and said I'd never be cold again. He lied about the cold.

ember.name: Ember Reyes
ember.intro: The docks are mine. Everything here burns if I say so.
ember.yield: ...It's out. I've never had it go out before.
ember.origin: A man in a grey suit handed me a black stone at my mother's funeral. It was warm. I thought that meant something.

dahlia.name: Dahlia Okafor
dahlia.intro: This road grows shut behind people I don't like.
dahlia.yield: You went round. Nobody goes round. They all push.
dahlia.origin: I was a florist. A customer in a grey suit paid with a black stone. Things grew after that. Too many things.

juno.name: Juno Park
juno.intro: Every sign on this street is on because of me. Watch.
juno.yield: Three. You counted to three. Ugh.
juno.origin: I fixed a neon sign for a man in a grey suit. He tipped with a black stone. I haven't needed a socket since.

rio.name: Rio Santos
rio.intro: Hear that? That's your heartbeat. I'm about to borrow it.
rio.yield: You came in on the off-beat. That's my move. That's MY move.
rio.origin: I was busking. A grey suit dropped a black stone in my hat. I could suddenly hear everyone's pulse.

mei.name: Mei Tanaka
mei.intro: Heads I win. Tails, also me. Want to see?
mei.yield: Three rolls. It's always three. How did you know it was three?
mei.origin: I won a black stone off a man in a grey suit. Only time I think he let me win.

bruno.name: Bruno Castellan
bruno.intro: Hit me. Go on. Everyone gets one.
bruno.origin: I worked the foundry. The owner, grey suit, gave every man on the night shift a black stone. I'm the only one still standing.

tomas.name: Tomas Vela
tomas.intro: Which one of us are you looking at? Wrong.
tomas.yield: You found me. People don't. Even I don't, some days.
tomas.origin: I cleaned windows uptown. Found a black stone on a sill, forty floors up. I looked into it and it looked back.

sable.name: Sable Marchetti
sable.intro: You won't hear me. Nobody does. It's restful.
sable.yield: You turned round. People never turn round.
sable.origin: I was a getaway driver who wanted to disappear. A grey suit said he could arrange it. He gave me a black stone and I haven't cast a shadow at noon since.

atlas.name: Atlas Novak
atlas.intro: Everything comes to me in the end. Rocks. Coins. You.
atlas.yield: Huh. You stayed away. Lonely way to win.
atlas.origin: I carried crates for a man in a grey suit. One of them was full of black stones. I kept one. Now everything's heavy but me.
